name: Fox's Patience

card.plain: The fox waits and learns: this special builds more spirit meter when the foe blocks it.
card.frames: Meter gain on block +25% (C5 default 3 becomes 4, rounded to nearest)

notes: Rules.md Modifiers table; the C5 attacker gain on block is 3, so +25% = 4 (E20). Any special can take it.
